description: This file defines the DisplayLink class, a plugin for Drupal Views that handles display link areas, including form building, validation, and rendering of links to other views displays, with specific focus on path-based displays.

classes.name: DisplayLink
classes.description: A Drupal Views plugin class that manages display link areas, providing options form, validation, and rendering logic for links between different view displays, especially path-based displays.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines default options for the display link, including display_id and label.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the options form for configuring the display link, including selecting allowed displays and setting label text.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the display link configuration, ensuring the linked display exists, is path-based, and options are consistent.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the display link as a Drupal link element, constructing URL with query parameters and CSS classes.

methods.name: isPathBasedDisplay
methods.description: Checks if a given display ID corresponds to a path-based display plugin.

methods.name: hasEqualOptions
methods.description: Checks if a display's options match the current display's options for a specific setting.
